title: Materials Informatics Scientist
text:
We’re hiring a Materials Informatics Scientist that will support efforts in machine learning-based prediction and experimental design in materials research problems
The ideal candidates have significant experience translating scientific concepts to numerical models, implementing scripts and software to solve problems, presenting problems and results in a detailed and coherent manner, and interfacing with clients of a wide variety of backgrounds. However, the most important prerequisite for this (or any!) position at Aionics is that applicants are willing to learn, committed to doing their best, and enthusiastic about the opportunity to shape our company’s culture, technology, and future.
Responsibilities
- Independently research different approaches to analyze data and solve materials design problems with machine learning-based approaches, and communicate results comprehensively to clients and management
- Plan, build, execute, and maintain scripts and software for data analysis and modeling pipelines for any of the wide variety of problems that we work on
- Visualize complex, multi-dimensional data
- Communicate key findings clearly and comprehensively to clients of widely varying backgrounds
- Disciplined and secure handling of client data, company data, and your own work to maintain privacy and robustness against infrastructural issues
Recommended Qualifications
- Ph.D. or Master’s degree in STEM, preferably the physical sciences
- Prior work or postdoc experience in the areas of materials informatics/cheminformatics and/or battery research
- Extreme attention to detail and unyielding principles in data handling and computational tool building
- Technical expertise with statistical learning and data-driven modeling
- Demonstrable experience producing professional-grade scripts and software
- Fluency with software development tools and ability to work coherently across computational environments
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
We know no applicant will check every box – above all, we value grit, enthusiasm, willingness to learn, and a do-whatever-it-takes attitude
How to apply
If interested, please click on the “Click here to Apply” button to submit your resume and cover letter .
Aionics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Software Engineering Manager
text:
Company
Aionics is a company that lives at the intersection of materials science and artificial intelligence. We use our best-in-class simulation and machine learning capabilities, in partnership with some of the world’s largest manufacturers, to design next-generation materials for leading OEMs in automotive, grid scale energy storage, green manufacturing, and more. Our mission is to leverage the dual revolutions in high-performance computing and machine learning to discover and commercialize new materials for the clean energy economy. We are not selling software — we are selling materials.
Position
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineering Manager to join our dynamic team of scientists and computer engineers. You will be responsible for leading a team of software engineers and participating in the design, implementation, and operation of a data- and AI-driven materials design platform that changes the way batteries are developed.
The ideal candidate would be a highly-skilled full stack software developer with team leadership experience and customer focus. Prior experience in supporting AI/ML platforms and Data Engineering is highly desired. The selected candidate will need to help architect our platform, prioritize functionality in coordination with our scientific and commercial teams, manage the team’s backlog, manage (and contribute to) delivery of functionality according to specifications. As this is an early stage start-up, we need someone who is not afraid to get their hands dirty and enjoys putting initial structure around processes. A background in the physical sciences, specifically in chemistry or materials engineering (atomistic simulations, battery engineering) is highly desired.
This is a hybrid position with in-person work in our Palo Alto office expected at least three days per week (Tue-Thu).
We welcome all levels of team leaders to apply. We are people-centric at Aionics: we believe in tailoring the job description and title around the right individual, not the other way around.
Responsibilities
- Work with the executive team to help define the company’s technical roadmap and long-term vision, aligning it with business goals, market trends, and team capabilities
- Manage and mentor a team of software engineers team with diverse skills, including regular meetings to assess timelines and provide technical feedback on recent developments
- Oversee the development and management of robust software solutions to deliver short-term results and build long-term tools
- Drive technical discussions and decisions, ensuring adherence to best practices and architectural guidelines.
- Manage computational infrastructure, including cloud-based tooling (VMs, databases, and storage) and team development tools (internal user accounts, git repositories)
- Manage hiring processes to grow our engineering team at the right pace to provide for short- and long-term goals
- Represent the detailed capabilities and needs of the engineering team in high-level planning and scoping
- Operationalize AI/ML algorithms and models to solve complex business problems and enhance product capabilities.
- Design and optimize data pipelines for collecting, processing, and analyzing large volumes of data.
- Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends and assess their potential impact on our products and services.
Qualifications
- B.S. degree in STEM field (Ph.D. or M.S. preferred) with at least 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on cloud-based solutions and distributed systems
- 2+ years of experience managing software development teams
- Demonstrated experience in managing and prioritizing software specifications and development process
- Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools
- Ability to set clear expectations and paint a compelling vision that inspires action
- Strong proficiency in AWS cloud services and infrastructure automation
- Demonstrated expertise in AI/ML technologies, including familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
- Experience with data engineering tools and frameworks
- Familiarity with materials science concepts and applications is desired.
- Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.
We know no applicant will check every box – above all, we value grit, enthusiasm, willingness to learn, and a do-whatever-it-takes attitude.
Benefits
- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
- Unlimited paid time off/sick leave
- 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Two-week full company holiday at year’s end
- Hybrid schedule with some flexibility (on-site 3x per week)
How to apply
If interested, please click on the “Click here to Apply” button to submit your resume and cover letter .
Aionics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Financial Modeling Internship (Technoeconomics)
text:
We’re hiring a Techno-economics Analysis Intern to explore the commercial factors that influence our technology. This role combines economic expertise with scientific know-how to develop our products. The ideal candidates will have experience in applying economic models to real-world scenarios, especially in the realm of energy, batteries, and mobility. However, the most important prerequisite for this (or any!) position at Aionics is that applicants are willing to learn, committed to doing their best, and enthusiastic about the opportunity to shape our company’s culture, technology, and future.
Responsibilities
- Research sales and forecasts of Aionics target markets
- Create financial (techno-economic) models for energy and mobility markets using economic principles, market knowledge, technology forecasts, and data science methods
- Aggregate, clean and prepare datasets from multiple sources
- Contribute to and help manage internal data repository of commercial data
Recommended Qualifications
- Enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program or higher in related fields such as finance, economics, business, data science or STEM.
- Experience conducting research on energy or technology markets and/or consumer behavior
- Strong data analysis skills; experience with programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL is preferred
- Ability to work independently and collaborate with a remote team
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
- Experience with energy storage and mobility technologies or markets is a plus
- We know no applicant will check every box – above all, we value grit, enthusiasm, willingness to learn, and a do-whatever-it-takes attitude

With a mission to harness the power of high-performance computing and AI, we accelerate the discovery and commercialization of innovative materials to drive the clean energy economy forward.

We’re seeking a Head of Business Development with a strong understanding of the commercial elements of energy storage technology, across OEMs (automotive, aerospace), cellmakers, and chemical suppliers. This role requires both strategic insight and hands-on involvement to cultivate key partnerships and support Aionics’ growth in these markets. title: Laboratory Technician - Advanced Materials
text:
*Only candidates based in France and with a Valid Work Permit will be considered*
About us
Altrove is a rapidly growing startup developing new inorganic materials using cutting edge AI and lab automation. We are supported by top investors and partners and have built a very strong team of stellar talent and ambition. At altrove, you will be tackling the biggest materials challenges of the century, solving the mineral crisis threatening the energy transition.
Role and responsibility
We're looking for a motivated, get-s*it-done attitude lab technician to join our great team in the early days.
Your responsibilities include :
- Prepare the inorganic powder samples by weighing, mixing and grinding.
- Sample handling and moving to the designated stations.
- Prepare and characterize the physical and chemical properties of inorganic materials.
- Accurately record data and prepare detailed reports.
- Ensure compliance with safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized lab environment.
- Working with and assisting our team of experts with the synthesis of groundbreaking materials.
- Assist in the development and optimization of new laboratory methods and procedures.
Qualifications
- You have previous experience as a lab technician or a similar role.
- Skills in electronics, including maintenance and repair of laboratory equipment is a plus.
- You speak fluent English (the day-to-day language is in English) and French.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of laboratory safety protocols and best practices.
- Organized, and ability to accurately record data.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- Must have a valid work permit for France.
This is a job for an early stage, ambitious and fast growing startup, which involves high ownership and responsibility and requires flexibility. It is also highly rewarding. You will have a strong and direct impact on the startup.
You will have a competitive package, have the possibility to own shares in the company and will work on the most fascinating topics you can imagine.

title: Inorganic Materials Engineer - Manufacturing and Process Design
text:

- Distribution - assess cost structures, distribution channels, geographical challenges and regulatory obligations
- Partnerships - scout, approach, negotiate and close the most relevant partners to safely (and in full trust) distribute or co-manufacture with.

- Technical background or proven track record working in a technical environment
- Significant experience tackling manufacturing challenges and onboarding key industrial partners
- Previous success working with executives at medium and large industrial companies
- Savviness on AI and materials development challenges
- Ability to take responsibility and be autonomous
- Get-s*it-done attitude
- Fluent English
You will work on solving a generational problem along with a world-class team. You will have the possibility to own shares in the company and will work in a fast-paced, fascinating environment.

title: ML Engineer
text:
About Altrove
Founded by a successful repeat entrepreneur and a top technical CTO (PhD Materials Science from Cambridge University), we're a rapidly growing startup, supported by Tier 1 investors and partners. We're tackling the biggest materials challenges of the century, creating better alternatives to the most critical materials. At altrove, we are bridging the gap between crystal structure prediction and inorganic material synthesis by using our deep AI expertise and high-throughput laboratory.
Job Description
We are looking for a Research Scientist/Engineer with strong machine learning fundamentals to fine-tune, deploy, and operationalize in order to power Altrove's internal AI scientist. You'll be building models and pipelines to help understand the modelling and reasoning of scientific research in Altrove's high-throughput lab. You will be deploying tasks at the intersection of ML research, software engineering, and materials science.
What you'll do:
- Build and maintain ML training and inference pipelines that directly interface with scientific experiments
- Develop algorithms that operate well in high-noise environments while reasoning on obtained results
- Deploy pipelines across distributed HPC/Cloud systems
- Collaborate with computational and experimental materials scientists
- Contribute to data management
Qualifications
- A degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics or a related technical field, as well as subsequent work experience (of PhD) applying ML methods
- Strong machine learning fundamentals
- Solid PyTorch experience and ability to build reliable training pipelines
- Experience fine-tuning pretrained models
- Deep learning experience on multimodal or scientific data
- Good judgment in low-data, noisy-data settings
- Rigorous evaluation habits and strong experimental discipline
Nice to have
- Experience with Markov Processes, active learning, and/or Bayesian optimisation
- Experience with materials foundation models
- Familiarity with LLM-based scientific workflows
- Experience with modern ML development (training, evaluation, inference, distributed systems).
You will work on solving a generational problem along with a world-class team. You will have the possibility to own shares in the company and will work in a fast-paced, fascinating environment.

- Very organized and thorough
- Get-s*it-done attitude, stellar ownership and autonomy
- Fluent English a must, French a bonus.
You will work on solving a generational problem along with a world-class team. You will have the possibility to own shares in the company and will work in a fast-paced, fascinating environment.
What We Offer
- A CDI (permanent contract) with competitive compensation.
- A front-row seat to one of the most ambitious deeptech ventures in Europe, working directly with the founding team.
- Equity (BSPCE)

title: Talent and Acquisition Specialist
text:
Who we are
Chemify is rapidly building the infrastructure to fully digitize chemistry to design, discover, and manufacture new molecules. We have developed a set of χDL driven robotic synthesis platforms to automate and optimise tough synthetic routes. This allows us to synthesize complex biologically active molecules more quickly, reliably and safely than is possible elsewhere.
χDL is a platform agnostic chemical synthesis language, allowing synthetic procedures to be codified, and run across different hardware set ups without modification of the source file. Our extensive library of χDL files allows our chemists to remake any molecule in our database without spending time on method development and condition optimization. It also accelerates our  in silico  reaction prediction capability where a foundation of abundant, reliable and structured data is of critical importance.

title: Senior Data Scientist - AI/ML (CADD)
text:
About Chemify
Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world’s largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.
Job Description:
We seek a talented and motivated Senior AI/ML Data Scientist to pioneer the development and application of cutting-edge machine learning models for computer-aided drug design (CADD) and small molecule discovery.
​
You will be joining a dynamic, cross-disciplinary team of computational scientists, medicinal chemists, and engineers. Your primary focus will be on architecting, training, and deploying sophisticated models to predict molecular properties, generate novel models, and ultimately accelerate our drug discovery pipelines.
​
To be successful in this role, you will need deep expertise in modern machine learning, particularly generative AI (Transformers, Diffusion Models), Graph Neural Networks, and predictive modeling. You will leverage your skills to tackle complex scientific challenges, working with vast and diverse chemical and biological datasets.
​
If you are passionate about applying state-of-the-art AI to solve fundamental challenges in chemistry and are driven to see your work make a real-world impact on discovering new medicines, we’d love to have you join our team.
​
Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and optimize state-of-the-art generative models (e.g., Transformers, GNNs, Diffusion Models) for robotic tasks synthetic routes.
- Architect and implement scalable MLOps pipelines for preprocessing large-scale chemical and biological datasets, model training, and rigorous evaluation.
- Translate cutting-edge research in AI/ML into practical solutions that address critical challenges in our drug discovery projects, such as property prediction (ADMET/QSAR), reaction prediction, and binding affinity prediction.
- Collaborate closely with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and software engineers to define project goals, interpret model outputs, and integrate AI-driven insights into our discovery platform.
- Design and execute robust experiments to evaluate model performance, focusing on chemical validity, novelty, synthesizability, and predictive accuracy against experimental data.
- Clearly communicate complex technical concepts, model results, and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Stay at the forefront of AI for drug discovery, foundation models for science, and multimodal learning, continuously identifying and championing opportunities to enhance our capabilities.
​
What you’ll bring:
- MSc or PhD with 5+ years of industry or academic experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a closely related field.
- Demonstrated proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of modern machine learning architectures, including Transformers, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and generative models (VAEs, GANs, Diffusion Models) as applied to scientific problems.
- Proven ability to lead complex AI/ML projects from concept to deployment in a scientific or drug discovery context.
- Extensive experience working with large-scale molecular datasets (e.g., SMILES, 3D conformations), biological data (e.g., protein sequences, assay data), and other scientific data formats.
- Experience with efficient model training and fine-tuning techniques, such as LoRA, quantization, distillation, and model pruning.
- Strong background or hands-on experience applying ML to problems involving protein structures, small molecule interactions, or related biological data.
- Familiarity with scalable computing environments, GPU acceleration, and distributed training.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration in a multidisciplinary team.
- A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively within a cross-disciplinary team.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive, can-do attitude.
- An eagerness to learn new scientific concepts, computational methods, and software engineering practices from experienced mentors.
- Good understanding of version control with Git.
Beneficial Skills:
- Hands-on experience with cheminformatics toolkits such as RDKit.
- Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including vector databases (e.g., Redis, FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone) for querying large chemical or biological databases.
- Experience with Protein/DNA language models (e.g., ProtBERT, ESM, Evo) or protein structure prediction models (e.g., AlphaFold-like approaches).
- Experience with evaluation frameworks for reaction and synthetic route design, including human-in-the-loop assessment and metrics for novelty, diversity, and feasibility of synthetic pathways.
- Strong experience with relational and non-relational databases (SQL/NoSQL), including data modeling and efficient querying for large-scale AI workflows.
- A portfolio of projects or open-source contributions (e.g., a GitHub profile) that demonstrates your skills and passion for AI/ML development.

Procurement & Sourcing:

• Support the development, documentation, and continuous improvement of procurement-related SOPs and workflows.

title: CADD Scientist / Senior CADD Scientist
text:
Location : Glasgow
About Chemify:
Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world's largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.
Our Chemifarm facility in Glasgow operates a growing fleet of advanced robotic systems that automate synthesis, optimisation, and library generation. This gives our computational scientists something rare: a direct, high-throughput bridge from in silico design to physically synthesised molecules, closing the design–make–test loop at a pace conventional drug discovery organisations cannot match.
The Role
We are seeking a CADD Scientist to drive computer-aided drug design on Chemify's commercial programmes and computational platform. You will sit within a cross-disciplinary team — computational chemists, in-house and partner medicinal chemists, AI researchers, data engineers, and automation scientists — and help translate structure, simulation, and machine learning into molecules we actually make.
What sets this role apart is the design–make–test loop: working directly with partner chemists on medicinal-chemistry strategy, you will design and prioritise molecules for synthesis and see them physically made on our robotic platform within days rather than months.
If you are energised by solving complex problems at the intersection of chemistry, physics, and AI — and by seeing your designs synthesised and tested in days — we'd love to welcome you to our team.
Key Responsibilities
- Run computational design across the CADD stack — docking, pharmacophore, shape and 3D-similarity, MD, FEP, and QSAR — choosing appropriate physics- and ML-based approaches for each question.
- Design, enumerate, and prioritise molecules and libraries for synthesis, and triage and analyse the results across DMTL cycles.
- Work with in-house and partner chemists on MPO, translating SAR and diverse assay readouts into actionable, biologically relevant design hypotheses.
- Communicate computational reasoning, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to working chemists and project leads.
- Apply modern deep learning for molecular design (GNNs, generative models, property prediction) where it complements traditional CADD methods.
- Contribute to productionising CADD methods into a reproducible, API-first toolkit; partner with Infrastructure on cost-effective GPU/HPC workflows.
- Own the computational design strategy on assigned programmes from hit discovery through lead optimisation; mentor junior CADD scientists, partner with the Head of Advanced Machine Learning on growth, and act as the scientific interface with customers.
About You
You are a credible computational chemist who is equally comfortable reasoning about protein–ligand interactions and shipping code that runs in production. You care about getting real molecules made, not only writing elegant methods.
We expect you to bring:
- PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computational Chemistry, Structural Biology, Biophysics, Physics, or a closely related field — with 2+ years (CADD Scientist) or 5+ years (Senior) of hands-on CADD experience in small-molecule drug discovery.
- Grounding in both structure- and ligand-based drug design — protein–ligand biophysics on one side, and pharmacophore, shape, and SAR-driven design on the other — with hands-on use of the standard CADD stack (e.g. MOE, PyMOL, OpenMM / GROMACS / AMBER).
- Familiarity with core drug discovery and medicinal chemistry principles, and the ability to translate diverse assay readouts into biologically relevant design hypotheses.
- Strong Python and at least one core cheminformatics toolkit (e.g. RDKit, OpenEye); real experience inside the drug-discovery loop (SAR, MPO, DMTL cycles, library enumeration); comfort with GPU-accelerated simulation and cloud/HPC workflows.
- Working knowledge of modern deep learning for molecular design (GNNs, generative models, property prediction), and a clear sense of when these complement traditional CADD methods rather than replace them.
- (Senior level) A track record of owning the computational strategy on active programmes, and of technical leadership — mentoring and influencing scientific direction beyond your own projects.
Beneficial Skills
- Hands-on experience with free energy perturbation (FEP+, OpenFE, or equivalent) in a production drug-discovery setting.
- Practical use of generative chemistry methods (diffusion, autoregressive, RL-based design), including a clear-eyed view of their failure modes.
- Familiarity with active learning, iterative DMTL design loops, and Bayesian optimisation applied to molecular design.
- Experience building or integrating CADD tooling into API-first platforms (FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD), and proficiency in C/C++ / CUDA for high-performance computational chemistry.
- A visible track record in the field — peer-reviewed publications, open-source contributions, or public projects that demonstrate your judgement on real CADD problems.
Why Join Chemify?
Impact:
​ You will directly shape the molecules Chemify designs and makes — at a company uniquely positioned to close the design–make–test loop through automated chemical synthesis at scale.
Autonomy:
Reporting to the Head of Advanced Machine Learning, you will shape the computational platform behind every project at Chemify.
Ambition:
We are a Series B deep-tech company investing in world-class infrastructure and tackling problems at the frontier of AI, robotics, and chemistry. You will have the resources, the data, and the mandate to do CADD in a way that isn't possible elsewhere.

title: Senior Software Engineer
text:

About Chemify
Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world's largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.
The Role
Everything Chemify does runs on the Unified Data Platform. When a molecule is designed, registered, sourced, synthesised by a robot, tested, and shipped, the platform is what carries it, one canonical identity for every chemical entity, one trusted answer for its properties and hazards, one record of what was actually made and shipped to clients.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own crucial parts of that platform. This is a genuinely full-stack role: you'll own applications end-to-end, the interfaces chemists and operations staff use every day, the services behind them, and the data pipelines that feed them.
The platform spans seven domains, chemical identity and registration, chemical safety, inventory, sourcing, reaction data, reference data, and the shared infrastructure underneath. You won't work across all of it, but you won't be boxed into one corner either. We'll match your area to your strengths and appetite, and we expect that to change as the platform grows. What stays constant is the level of ownership: your systems, your architecture calls, your users.
You'll work in a tight-knit, cross-functional environment spanning software, chemistry, operations, and programme management, the kind of place where curiosity across disciplines is an asset, not a distraction.
If you enjoy solving complex technical problems that make a real-world impact, are a natural communicator, and are energised by working closely with scientists using cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Work On
Applications people rely on daily. Full ownership of user-facing systems used by chemists, analysts, and operations teams across multiple sites, from the interface through to the data model.
Services that are the single source of truth. Registration and reference services where being authoritative matters, and where every other system is a consumer with its own expectations.
Domain modelling that has to be right. Chemical entities, batches, lineage, properties, hazards. These are hard models with real edge cases, and the abstractions you choose will outlive the code.
Data pipelines and orchestration. Dagster pipelines feeding a versioned data lake and a warehouse serving multiple use cases, with the reproducibility and governance that scientific data demands.
Reconciling sources that disagree. External datasets, vendor systems, and instruments that each claim a different truth, promoting trusted values into the systems everyone else depends on.
Key Responsibilities
- Own the full lifecycle of the applications and services in your area: scoping, architecture, development, deployment, and monitoring production.
- Design data models and workflows covering a wide range of use cases across AI chemistry, synthesis, and manufacturing.
- Build and maintain robust, observable pipelines for internal, client-specific, and literature data.
- Work directly with chemists and operations staff to understand how the work actually happens, not how the spec says it happens.
- Collaborate with Infrastructure to ensure new work is soundly architected and production-ready.
- Define and champion engineering and data best practices: versioning, testing, documentation, governance, data contracts.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to communities of practice across the team.
- Contribute to team-wide initiatives: code reviews, design discussions, ADRs, process improvements, and workstream planning.
What You'll Bring
Core
- Significant commercial software engineering experience.
- Strong Python, with production experience in FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar.
- PostgreSQL fluency, schema design, query optimisation, and ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy/SQLModel.
- Commercial experience with TypeScript and React, and a genuine interest in UI/UX.
- Experience building and maintaining data-intensive applications, you're comfortable on both sides of the application/data boundary.
- Comfortable with containerised deployments (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, ArgoCD).
- Hands-on with AWS or another major cloud platform.
- Experience integrating with systems you don't own, negotiating contracts, handling partial failure, and enabling teams to own their data.
- You've genuinely rewired how you work around AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent), this is part of how we work, not a nice-to-have.
- Strong communicator, genuinely collaborative, comfortable with non-technical domain experts as your primary users.
Infrastructure & Data
- Working knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS, comfortable deploying to and reasoning about containerised workloads in a managed K8s environment.
- Experience orchestrating pipelines with Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar.
- Solid grasp of ETL concepts and production-grade pipeline design.
​ Beneficial Skills
- Interest in chemistry, life sciences, robotics, or manufacturing.
- Hands-on experience with scientific data, chemical, biological, or laboratory.
- Experience building systems where the data model represents physical things, and being out of sync with reality has consequences.
- Previous experience in AI drug discovery is a genuine differentiator for us.
- Interest in semantic technologies (graph databases, ontologies) or modern data stack.
- Experience enabling analytics teams by building data models for BI tools and dashboards.
- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK or Terraform) is a strong plus.
- Experience with product design thinking and tools such as Figma.
- A degree in Computer Science, a scientific discipline, or a related field, useful, not required. We care what you've built.
Why Join Chemify?
Impact: You'll own foundational parts of the platform that every other team at Chemify builds on, accelerating discovery and unlocking new possibilities in science and medicine.
Ownership: Real architectural authority over systems that matter, not tickets from someone else's backlog.
Autonomy: Reporting to the VP Software Engineering, you'll have genuine influence over technical direction and product quality.
Ambition: Series B, scaling rapidly, tackling problems at the frontier of robotics, AI, and chemistry. We're building the right foundations for the future.

title: Synthetic Chemist
text:
Analysis review scientist – NMR & UPLC-MS interpretation
About Chemify
Chemify is creating a future where important molecules, drugs and currently unimaginable new materials are instantly accessible; thereby radically increasing the speed of innovation, quality of life, and reach of humanity. The company is building the infrastructure to digitize chemistry for the design, discovery and synthesis of new molecules with the desired function and properties instantly and on-demand. Chemify has built a platform that combines purpose-built programming languages, robotics, AI, and the world's largest and continuously growing database of chemical programs to accelerate chemical discovery to new, transformative heights.
Chemify is supported by some of the best investors from Silicon Valley and across the world, including Triatomic Capital, BlueYard Ventures, DCVC, Founders Fund, and others.
What we offer
You'll join our analysis review team interpreting 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data generated by our automated synthesis platform, playing a direct and critical role in keeping our chemistry pipeline moving. You'll also get exposure to a wide variety of organic chemistry reactions passing through the platform — genuinely interesting territory if you enjoy the puzzle of structure elucidation. This is an entry point into the synthetic chemistry industry, with full training provided. Working a shift pattern that includes evenings and weekends, you'll also earn a competitive uplift for unsocial hours on top of your base salary.
Job purpose
As our Analysis Review Scientist, you will review and interpret 1H-NMR and UPLC-MS data produced by our automated chemistry platform, confirming that reactions and purifications have produced the expected outcome, flagging anomalies for further investigation, and generating high-quality reports. This is a computer-based role, working with digital spectra and data files rather than at the bench. The role follows a structured, repeatable process across a high volume of samples each shift, and forms part of a rota that includes evenings and weekends to keep pace with round-the-clock synthesis.
Who we are looking for
We're looking for an entry-level scientist — ideal for a recent chemistry graduate or someone early in their career — who is comfortable with focused, detail-oriented work performed to a consistent standard. You'll have a working knowledge of 1H-NMR and mass spectrometry from your studies or lab experience, a methodical approach to spotting when something doesn't match expectations, and the flexibility to work a rota that includes evenings and weekends. Strong communication matters too: you'll work closely with our synthesis program manager team on interpreting outcomes, and may occasionally liaise with the operations team when troubleshooting instrument or pipeline issues.
Key responsibilities
• Data interpretation: Review 1H-NMR spectra and UPLC-MS traces against expected reaction and purification outcomes, confirming success or diagnosing likely products and where a reaction may have gone wrong, to help inform future runs.
• Volume and turnaround: Process a high throughput of samples each shift to keep pace with the automated synthesis platform, maintaining consistent accuracy and speed.
• Shift coverage: Work a rota that includes evenings and weekends, providing near-continuous data turnaround for the chemistry team.
• Escalation: Flag ambiguous or unexpected spectra to senior scientists for further review, and report issues with the software platform or automated processing and verification steps.
• Record keeping: Maintain accurate, consistent records of interpretations and decisions in line with SOPs.
• Quality and compliance: Follow SOPs and quality procedures for data review and support timely investigation of flagged discrepancies or audit findings.
• Continuous improvement: Feedback patterns or recurring issues you spot to help refine interpretation guidelines over time, collaborating cross-functionally in line with one of Chemify's core values.
Qualifications and experience
Essential
• Education: PhD in synthetic chemistry, or equivalent experience — no prior industry experience required
• Technical grounding: Working knowledge of LC/HPLC/UPLC data, including mass spectrometry and UV/Vis and/or ELSD detection, gained through study or lab work
• NMR experience: Experience interpreting 1H-NMR data, with some basic structure elucidation experience expected
• Organic chemistry knowledge: A solid understanding of organic chemistry, to make sense of the reactions under review and anticipate likely side products or impurities
• Working style: Comfortable with repetitive, detail-oriented work carried out to a consistent standard
• Flexibility: Able to work a rotating shift pattern that includes evenings and weekends
• Communication: Good written and verbal communication, both for recording findings clearly and discussing reaction outcomes with senior scientists
Desired (not essential)
• 2D NMR interpretation: Experience interpreting 2D NMR data (e.g. COSY, HSQC, HMBC) for more complex structure elucidation
• Software: Experience with MestreNova or similar NMR processing software — full training will be provided if not
Compensation and working pattern
A competitive base salary, plus an uplift for unsocial hours worked as part of your shift pattern, and enhanced annual leave on top of the standard entitlement. Full training is provided from day one; after this initial period, the role offers the flexibility to work partially or fully remotely.
Growth opportunities
This is an entry point into our analysis review team, with a clear path toward more senior roles. There's also potential to get involved in building out the automation of our analytical data processing and interpretation work, in collaboration with our software team, as the platform grows.
Location
Initial training will be based at our Glasgow site. After this, the role offers flexibility to work partially remotely.
UK right to work
Please note that the company are unable to sponsor visas for this role.

title: Automation Scientist
text:
About Chemify
Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world’s largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.
Our Chemifarm facility in Glasgow operates a growing fleet of advanced robotic systems that automate synthesis, optimisation, and library generation. This gives our computational scientists something rare: a direct, high-throughput bridge from in silico design to physically synthesised molecules, closing the design–make–test loop at a pace conventional drug discovery organisations cannot match.
Location: Glasgow, UK (on-site)
Travel: Minimal
The Role
We are seeking an Automation Scientist to sit at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, and testing — translating real chemistry onto our robotic synthesis platform and making sure it works. You will take synthetic routes and turn them into automated protocols, run and validate them on our robotic systems, diagnose issues that span chemistry, hardware, firmware, and software, and feed what you learn back to the engineering teams building the platform.
What sets this role apart is the hybrid: you will need a chemist’s judgement, an engineer’s instinct for how the machines work, and a tester’s rigour — all on a platform where code becomes molecules.
If working across chemistry, engineering, and testing on a real-world robotic platform sounds like the right shape of job for you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.
Key Responsibilities
- Translate synthetic chemistry into automated protocols that run on our robotic platform.
- Run, validate, and troubleshoot syntheses end to end, diagnosing issues across chemistry, hardware, firmware, and software.
- Act as the bridge between the chemistry and engineering teams, turning lab reality into clear, actionable feedback.
- Define and run test protocols and acceptance criteria that prove the platform performs against real chemistry.
- Help characterise and improve platform capability, reliability, and reproducibility.
- Contribute to protocols, documentation, and the standards that make automated chemistry repeatable. About You
You are a scientist who likes machines — as comfortable reasoning about a reaction as about the robot running it. You enjoy being the person who works out why something did not behave, whether the cause is chemistry, hardware, or code, and you communicate clearly across disciplines.
We expect you to bring:
- A degree in chemistry or a related science (PhD or equivalent hands-on experience welcome), with real synthetic / wet-lab experience.
- A strong practical bent and genuine interest in automation, robotics, and how the underlying systems work.
- Experience running, validating, and troubleshooting experiments rigorously and reproducibly.
- The ability to work across chemistry, engineering, and software teams and translate between them.
- Careful, methodical working and clear record-keeping. Beneficial Skills
- Experience with automated or high-throughput synthesis / lab systems.
- Familiarity with analytical techniques (e.g. HPLC, LC-MS, NMR) for validating outcomes.
- Some scripting ([Python]) for protocols, data handling, or analysis.
- Exposure to flow chemistry, process chemistry, or lab-automation hardware.
- An understanding of how software and hardware combine to run an experiment.
Why Join Chemify?
Impact.   You are where chemistry meets the machine — your work is what turns our platform’s capability into real, reproducible synthesis.
Autonomy.   You will own the translation of chemistry onto the platform and the testing that proves it works, with real influence over how we make automated chemistry reliable.
Ambition.   We are a Series B deep-tech company at the frontier of chemistry, robotics, and AI — a chance to work across chemistry, engineering, and automation on systems no one else has.

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design and develop the mechanical systems that make up our robotic synthesis platform — the fluidic handling, motion assemblies, enclosures, and instrument modules that physically carry out chemistry. You will take designs from concept through detailed CAD, prototyping, and testing into production, working closely with electronics, firmware, and manufacturing engineers.
What sets this role apart is that your designs do not just move — they handle real reagents and run real chemistry, so precision, reliability, and material compatibility matter as much as elegant mechanics.

- Partner with electronics and firmware engineers on integrated electromechanical modules.
- Work with manufacturing and supply chain on design-for-manufacture, materials, and component selection.
- Contribute to design reviews and the team’s mechanical standards. About You
You are a hands-on mechanical engineer who enjoys taking a design from sketch to working hardware. You sweat the details — tolerances, materials, manufacturability — and you like seeing your parts come together and move in the real world.
We expect you to bring:
- Proven experience in mechanical design engineering, ideally for precision electromechanical or robotic hardware.
- Strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) and detailed drawing / GD&T experience.
- Sound grasp of mechanisms, materials, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacture.
- Hands-on prototyping and testing experience.
- Close collaboration with electronics, firmware, and manufacturing engineers. Beneficial Skills
- Experience with fluidics, pumps, valves, or motion systems.
- Exposure to lab instrumentation, robotics, or automation hardware.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes (machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, 3D printing).
- FEA or tolerance-stack analysis.
Why Join Chemify?
Impact.   The mechanical systems you design are the body of our platform — your work is what physically carries out chemistry in the Chemifarm.
Autonomy.   You will own mechanical design across modules and shape how our hardware is built.
Ambition.   We are a Series B deep-tech company at the frontier of chemistry, robotics, and AI — with the resources and mandate to design mechanical systems for a platform unlike anything else.

text:

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.
We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.
We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.
We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.
The Role
Due to rapid growth in our core AI capabilities, we are seeking an experienced Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents) to design and build the intelligent agents that power our autonomous materials discovery engine.
Your Impact
You will be instrumental in developing the "artificial brain" of our agentic materials discovery engine. This is responsible for orchestrating complex, closed-loop scientific workflows, autonomously making decisions, running simulations , and driving experimental campaigns to find breakthrough materials faster than ever before.
Your work will directly accelerate CuspAI’s path to finding solutions for global sustainability challenges.
What You Will Do
Agentic systems
- Design the agentic framework that powers our platform to discover new materials. This includes spanning dynamic, multi-stage simulation workflows from literature-grounded hypothesis generation through to computational and experimental validation
- Build the integration that connects agents to ML models, simulation engines, databases, and heterogeneous compute backends
- Design pipelines that let agents autonomously plan, schedule, execute, and interpret computational tasks at scale and over long periods of time
- Use expert annotations from the Chemistry team to drive targeted improvements in agent planning, retrieval, and decision-making
- Create evaluations to measure the effectiveness of agents
Experimental design
- Build agents that perform experimental design — applying Bayesian optimization, active learning, or related sequential decision-making methods to decide what to compute or measure next, and to balance exploration and exploitation across long-running discovery campaigns
- Help close the loop between simulation and physical experiments so that outcomes become durable knowledge — feeding back into what agents know and how their models reason — compounding across campaigns.
- Develop strategies for multi-fidelity and multi-objective decision-making , where agents must trade off cost, time, and uncertainty across simulations and physical experiments
Interdisciplinary Collaboration
- Work closely with Chemists, Materials Scientists, and the rest of the Agent team to co-develop our core orchestration intelligence
- Work on customer projects and implement the direct needs required for these projects
Must Have Skills and Qualifications:
- You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain , with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.
- Proficiency in the modern ML ecosystem such as PyTorch or JAX , with experience taking ML-driven systems from prototype to production
- Strong software engineering skills (building systems at scale in a production environment): testing, modular design, CI/CD, and scalable ML operations in production environments
- If you have a PhD or Masters degree and 4-5 yrs industry experience this would be ideal, but we will also consider you if you have a PhD and slightly less experience in industry
- You have a proactive builder mentality with a bias toward shipping and iteration
- Willingness to learn about materials science , and in particular experimental chemistry - to learn the vocabulary of the discipline to meaningfully interact with other stakeholders
- Experienced in LLM-assisted programming , knowing its strengths and weaknesses thoroughly.
Bonus Points (But Not Critical):
- Experience applying ML models specifically for materials science, chemistry, or drug discovery applications
- Experience with agentic frameworks and building LLM-powered applications
- Experience with sequential decision-making methods — Bayesian optimization, active learning, bandits, or reinforcement learning — applied to real-world systems
- Advanced agentic-reasoning techniques: planning models, self-improving systems, multi-tool agents, or RLHF/RLAIF workflows
Additional Considerations
This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices , with the expectation of being in the office three days per week . Additionally, there may be regular travel required to our other offices for collaboration and project oversight.
Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

- A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth
- Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

- ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together
- Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth
- Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques
- True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other

You will be embedded in our chemistry team and work closely with CuspAI colleagues.
Note: You would be joining as an engineering intern within the chemistry team at CuspAI.
Your Impact
You will deliver one of the foundational capabilities our simulation stack needs to evaluate the next generation of MOFs: an MLFF that is both accurate enough to replace classical force fields for guest–host interactions and fast enough to run inside the inner loop of GCMC. By distilling state-of-the-art equivariant models into a lightweight student potential and integrating the result directly into kUPS, you will expand what is computationally tractable for CuspAI and the wider gas adsorption community.
What You Will Do
Models
- Distill MLFFs into fast student potentials optimised for Monte Carlo simulations.
- Curate, version, and document training and validation datasets, including the distillation protocol and any active-learning loops used to close coverage gaps.
Integration & Validation
- Run head-to-head validation campaigns comparing the distilled MLFF against classical force-field baselines across a curated set of guest molecules, characterising accuracy, throughput, and failure modes.
Systems & Infrastructure
- Profile and optimise the pipeline for throughput, with particular focus on the MC inner loop where MLFF inference cost dominates.
- Benchmark accuracy/speed trade-offs systematically and document where the distilled model fails.
Science & Collaboration
- Collaborate with computational chemists on reference data generation, benchmark system selection, and validation strategy.
- Contribute to a publication establishing MLFF-driven GCMC for MOF screening.
Must Have Skills and Qualifications
- Currently enrolled in (or recently completed) a PhD or Master's programme in a relevant quantitative field (Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Computational Science, Machine Learning, or similar).
- Experience in adsorption modelling at the atomic scale.
- Hands-on experience with molecular simulation methods (GCMC, MD, or both).
- Comfortable working on Linux environments and managing simulation campaigns at scale.
- A genuine interest in the application of ML to chemistry and materials science.
Bonus Points (But Not Critical)
- Familiarity with modern MLFFs.
- Experience with knowledge distillation or other model compression techniques for scientific ML.
- Experience with active learning workflows for atomistic data.
- Familiarity with DFT data generation and the practicalities of curating atomistic datasets.
- Direct experience with established simulation packages.

title: Strategic Partnerships Manager (Platform Partnerships)
text:

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.
We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.
We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.
We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

In this role you will be building the foundational ecosystem of technical and academic alliances that fuel our R&D engine, which is critical for CuspAI’s mission to solve global challenges like carbon capture and clean energy.
Your main focus initially will be securing high-value compute agreements and establishing formal data-sharing partnerships with publishers, experimental labs, and academic institutions.     3. 博士（应届）毕业生，或硕士学历且具有 3 年及以上相关工作经验。
    4. 具备扎实的分子相互作用、蛋白-配体识别、热力学、构象动态及结构基础药物设计理论基础。
    5. 熟悉常规 CADD 技术体系，包括但不限于：分子对接（Docking）、分子动力学模拟（MD）、自由能微扰（FEP）、结构基础或配体基础药物设计方法， 熟悉常用的各类药物设计相关数据库；

加分项：
    1. 具有创新药研发或工业界药物发现项目经验者优先。
    2. 具备将计算结果与实验数据（如活性、亲和力、SAR、药效结果等）结合分析的经验。

title: High-Performance Computing Engineer
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1. 负责 AI4S 相关核心模块在不同硬件平台上的移植和优化，包括但不限于 x86/ARM CPU、GPU、昇腾以及其他 NPU；
2. 用 C++ 或 Rust 实现高性能组件，重点优化延迟、吞吐和内存占用，保证在不同硬件上的稳定表现；
3. 分析系统和算法的性能瓶颈（例如 CPU/GPU 利用率、内存带宽、缓存命中率、锁竞争等），给出并落地优化方案；
4. 针对不同硬件架构特点，做有针对性的优化工作，比如向量化（SIMD）、多线程并发、流水线、异步/零拷贝等；
5. 搭建和维护性能测试与分析环境，整理性能数据，输出评估报告，为算法和业务团队提供技术建议；
6. 和算法、后端、产品等团队一起协作，从原型阶段参与，推动方案真正落地并持续迭代优化；
7. 参与线上性能相关问题的排查、监控和调优，完善相关工具和脚本。  

Requirements (职位要求):
1. 计算机相关专业研究生及以上学历，计算机体系结构、操作系统、并行计算基础扎实；  
2. 熟练使用 C++ 或 Rust 做工程开发，有为提升性能而做架构和代码取舍的实际经验；
3. 至少熟悉一种并行/高性能编程模型或库，例如 CUDA、OpenCL、OpenMP、MPI，或常见 SIMD/向量化指令（如 AVX、NEON 等）；
4. 有性能分析和调优经验，使用过 perf、VTune、Nsight、火焰图等工具，对缓存 miss、分支预测失败、内存带宽瓶颈、锁竞争等问题有实际排查经验；
5. 数据结构和算法基础好，有数值计算、图计算、高性能网络或深度学习算子/内核优化经验者优先；
6. 了解主流深度学习框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow、MindSpore 等）的基本执行流程，有算子二次开发或自定义 kernel 经验更佳；
7. 了解典型主流 NPU / GPU 架构，有相关移植、调优经验者优先；
8. 能使用 Python 编写脚本、搭环境、做简单原型验证即可，不要求把 Python 当主语言；
9. 对新硬件、新工具、新编程模型有兴趣，愿意自己钻研，能独立把复杂性能问题分析到位。

title: Battery Simulation AI4S Development Intern
text:
Job description (职位描述):
电芯是一个跨尺度+多物理场融合的复杂系统，对电池工作和老化机理的模拟仿真有利于加速电芯的开发。您将基于AI For Science的研发范式，从AI+物理模型、AI+数据模型等多方面的先进算法和工程化实践，来系统性的支持电芯的研发。

岗位职责:
1. 开发电芯的热-力-电化学多物理场耦合模型和三维异构模型，并结合实验测试设计和分析验证，从参数和机理两方面不断修正和优化模型；
2. 开发离散元或粗粒化分子动力学算法来模拟极片制造过程，建立电芯极片的微观结构模型；
3. 开发电芯的材料-电芯跨尺度模型，探索材料微观相场-工艺过程离散元仿真-宏观多物理相场的耦合模型的模型开发和分析验证；
4. 开发各类能够有效描述电池老化过程的物理/数据模型和参数辨识算法，例如电化学模型、机理模型；
5. 开发AI先进算法，融合上述跨尺度模型、或者多物理场模型相结合，加速复杂电芯的快速仿真建模。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.了解商用电池体系的化学体系、电芯设计和工艺制造过程，熟悉电芯测试流程和各类模型参数的表征方法；
2. 至少熟练使用一款电芯仿真软件（COMSOL、AutoLion、star-CCM+），能够独立进行电化学模型、电热模型、多物理场模型等建模仿真工作，熟悉参数优化的各类算法，形成标准化、流程化的工作流；
3. 在电化学、材料科学、力学有较为扎实的理论基础，并熟练掌握1种以上编程语言（python、C++），具有较强的程序开发能力和数值计算分析能力，能够快速实现和验证前沿文献中的电池模型。

title: Senior Battery AI4S Development Researcher
title_original: 电池领域AI4S开发高级研究员
text:
Job description (职位描述):
作为深势科技“AI for Science”（AI4S）电池领域开发高级研究员，您将与团队的其他研究者与工程师合作，利用包括人工智能、分子模拟、离散元、连续介质模拟在内的跨尺度计算方法和AI模型，结合自身专业的电池领域背景，开发先进解决方案，研究电池领域从材料到电芯的关键问题，解决电池技术和对应工业领域的真需求真问题。深势科技持续关注AI4S新范式下的电池设计自动化（BDA）的创新效能和应用落地，您的开发成果将通过深势科技电池设计平台Piloteye 和先进研发方案组合等方式，为革新电池领域的研究范式和技术智能升级做出重要的贡献。

职位职责
1. 具有电池领域专家视角，面向电池开发的痛点问题和关键需求，利用AI4S新范式开发从材料-电极-电芯从微观到宏观的先进跨尺度算法工具和解决方案，加速电池开发白盒化；
2. 以计算-实验更高效结合为目标，开发电池材料-正负极、电解液、固态电解质及表界面等场景的AI&计算与高精度表征以及与工艺优化相结合的先进算法工具和解决方案；
3. 基于AI4S新范式，开发物理驱动和数据驱动的电池文献专利&多尺度计算&实验表征测试等大模型，构建从材料到器件的构效关系和开发失效分析及寿命预测的先进设施；
4. 以解决实际问题为导向，开发实验计算相融合的电池材料成分与性能数据库等，利用AI建模优化设计各类电池性能，打通电池开发全流程数据链条，加速寻找最优技术路线。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.具有电池或电化学等领域专业技术背景，有3～5年的电池研究经历能以专业的视角定义关键问题和领域需求，具有电池行业从业经历与电池实验或工业需求结合完成计算仿真项目经验者优先；
2.具有丰富的电池计算仿真与AI设计研究经验，至少熟练使用一款DFT、MD、介宏观等多尺度计算软件，具有机器学习算法工具与电池开发设计结合完成研发任务的能力；
3.具有面向应用研发和工程化领域开发者的能力和意愿，善于沟通和表达，勤于学习和思考，有较强的主观能动性和团队合作精神。

作为AI for Science创新算法研究员，您将与团队的其他研究者与工程师合作，利用包括人工智能、分子模拟在内的计算方法，研究新药研发、生物大分子计算、生物信息、材料设计、计算化学等广泛科学领域内的前沿问题，并为相应的学术与工业场景提供新的解决方案。深势科技持续关注创新算法的应用落地，您的研究成果不仅将产生高水平学术论文，还将通过深势科技药物设计平台等方式，为革新相应领域的研究与生产范式做出直接的贡献。 

岗位职责： 
1.深入认识和拆解相应领域的研究现状和真实需求，明确可行的研究问题； 
2.提出针对性的解决方案并编程验证； 
3.以论文、技术报告或开源代码形式汇总成果。 

Requirements (职位要求):
1.责任心强，对研究前沿问题具有热情，渴望探索与做出突破；
2.相关理工科专业本科及以上学历毕业，包含但不限于应用数学、计算机、人工智能、物理、计算化学、材料化学、生命科学等； 
3.熟悉包括人工智能、分子模拟、新药研发、生物大分子计算、生物信息、材料设计、计算化学等在内的一个或多个领域的最新前沿进展； 
4.具有一定编程能力，熟练使用以 Python 为代表的编程语言； 
5.能将关键问题汇总精练，对简单问题有独立解决的能力。 
加分项：在相关领域发表过高质量学术论文者优先。

title: Financial Accountant

title: Computational Biology Researcher
text:
Job description (职位描述):
岗位职责
    我们正在寻找一位优秀的计算机辅助药物设计科学家加入团队，利用先进的计算化学、分子模拟及人工智能辅助药物设计技术，支持创新药物发现与优化工作。候选人将面向不同药物形式开展计算研究，参与从早期发现到分子优化的关键环节，并与化学、生物、结构生物学等跨职能团队紧密合作，推动项目高效进展。
  
工作职责
    1. 基于计算辅助药物设计（CADD）策略，支持药物发现项目中的靶点分析、分子设计、候选化合物筛选与优化等工作。
    2. 熟练运用分子对接（Docking）、分子动力学模拟（MD）、自由能计算等常规计算方法，对分子-靶标相互作用机制进行研究和解释。
    3. 结合结构生物学、药物化学、计算化学及生物学信息，为项目提供可执行的分子设计建议与机制洞察。
    4. 跟踪并应用前沿的 AI驱动药物设计（AIDD）技术，包括但不限于分子生成、性质预测、分子打分、候选优选等相关方法。
    5. 支持药物研发相关项目的计算设计与分析工作。
    6. 能够独立完成计算结果分析、技术总结及方案汇报，并能够清晰地向项目团队传达研究结论。
    7. 与药化、生物、算法、数据科学等团队协同合作，推动计算策略在实际研发项目中的落地应用。
    8. 持续关注计算药物设计、分子模拟、自由能方法以及 AI for Drug Discovery 领域的最新进展，并推动新技术在项目中的应用。

Requirements (职位要求):
    1. 具有物理化学、计算化学、计算生物学、药物设计或相关专业背景；
    2. 具备良好的科学思维、分析能力与问题解决能力，能够独立承担课题并推动项目进展。
    3. 博士（应届）毕业生，或硕士学历且具有 3 年及以上相关工作经验。
    4. 具备扎实的分子相互作用、蛋白-配体识别、热力学、构象动态及结构基础药物设计理论基础。
    5. 熟悉常规 CADD 技术体系，包括但不限于：分子对接（Docking）、分子动力学模拟（MD）、自由能微扰（FEP）、结构基础或配体基础药物设计方法， 熟悉常用的各类药物设计相关数据库；
    6. 在小分子、多肽、抗体优化、RDC、ADC等一个或多个领域有相关经验；
    7. 熟练使用Linux系统，精通Python等至少一门编程语言；
    8. 能够将英语作为工作语言，流畅参与日常技术讨论、项目汇报及跨团队协作；
    9. 具有较强的团队合作意识和跨学科协作能力。
  
加分项
    1. 具有创新药研发或工业界药物发现项目经验者优先。
    2. 具备将计算结果与实验数据（如活性、亲和力、SAR、药效结果等）结合分析的经验。
    3. 具备机器学习的应用或开发经验者优先

title: Multimodal Large-Model Algorithm Intern

text:
Job description (职位描述):
参与多模态科学文献解析大模型算法的开发与研究，从非结构化的科学文献中，抽取结构化的信息，并用于下游更广泛的应用。内容包括且不限于科学图表理解，表格解析，反应式解析，通用OCR，多模态VQA，多模态RAG等，并对流程中某些部分算法进行深入探究，并将研究成果转化为学术论文。

1.多模态大模型训练各阶段方法设计与研究，解决多模态科学文献解析任务中的问题和需求；
2.参与大规模训练数据集的构建，确保数据质量和多样性；
3.进行模型性能分析，识别和解决训练过程中的瓶颈，优化推理效率。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.拥有扎实的编程能力，精通至少一种编程语言；
2.对计算机视觉或自然语言处理有一定经验和理解，两者都有最佳；
3.优秀的文献阅读能力与良好的沟通协作能力；
4.每周出勤不低于3天，可以base在北京/上海，亦可远程实习。

加分项：
1.熟悉多模态相关的算法和技术，具备多模态大模型训练经验，如QwenVL、InternVL、KimiVL、Gemma等
2.参与过多模态大模型相关重要开源项目，数据科学比赛优胜或发表相关论文。

title: AI Literature Recommendation and Knowledge Mining Intern

text:

我们正在为玻尔科研空间站招募实习生，我们的目标是通过AI智能推荐引擎和大语言模型（LLM）技术，彻底革新当前知识获取方式，突破传统文献检索的界限。更进一步，我们将 多模态数据挖掘 与 跨领域知识图谱 融入其中，逐步实现用 智能知识库与数据库 替代传统文献。你将有机会与顶尖的技术团队共同构建这一颠覆性系统，推动科研效率和知识发现的革命。

你将参与的核心任务：
1. AI文献推荐与检索系统——利用AI技术构建精准的文献推荐与检索系统，通过智能化算法让科研人员快速获取所需信息。
2. AI驱动的科研产品打磨——深度参与基于大模型的文献精读、期刊订阅、Notebook等科研产品迭代，推动智能科研工具落地！
3. 文献多模态数据与知识挖掘——解析分子式、化学式、表格、图片等多模态数据，构建知识图谱并智能链接科研文献，助力跨学科研究和深度知识发现！
4. 智能数据库革新——从传统文献向智能化数据库进化，构建分子数据库、靶点数据库、材料数据库等，为科研人员提供全新的知识获取方式。
5. 技术创新与实践应用——在推动前沿技术应用的同时，你将直接参与系统的技术架构设计与优化，推动科研知识获取方式的全面变革。

Requirements (职位要求):
我们希望你具备：
1. AI推荐与搜索技术——了解推荐算法、搜索引擎优化，能够思考并优化科研文献的个性化推荐策略。
2. LLM的原理与应用——熟悉大语言模型（如GPT、BERT）的机制，能在智能文献分析、知识问答等场景中探索应用。
3. 扎实的编程与数据处理能力——至少熟练掌握Python/Go等一门编程语言，具备数据处理和分析能力，熟悉相关大数据框架如Spark、Hadoop、Hive等优先。
4. 科研素养与好奇心——经常阅读科研论文，对科研人员的知识需求有深刻理解，能够助力文献推荐、分析和深度阅读。
5. 团队协作与创新精神——具备良好的团队协作能力，敢于挑战技术难题，能与不同学科背景的团队成员高效合作，共同推动项目创新！

你将收获：
🌍 直面全球科研挑战——参与AI+科研的最前沿应用，助力学术创新！
⚡ 顶尖技术实践——深入AI搜索推荐、知识图谱、LLM应用等核心技术栈，提升实战能力！
💡 导师辅导&成长机会——与顶级研发团队并肩作战，快速成长，积累宝贵行业经验！
🎯 全链路产品实践——直接参与智能科研工具的产品设计与优化，从0到1构建颠覆性系统！
🔥 颠覆传统，定义未来！我们等你来！
如果你渴望站在AI与科研交叉的最前沿，探索知识智能化的无限可能，欢迎加入我们，让AI驱动科研变革！

Requirements (职位要求):

5. 精通工业通讯协议配置和调试，包括但不限于 Modbus、Profinet、EtherCAT、CANopen；
6. 具备 Python 编程能力，能够开发通信接口、中间件或数据处理脚本；
7. 熟悉各类电气元件、伺服系统、传感器、机器人接口，有机器人系统集成经验优先；
8. 具备较强的项目管理意识，良好的沟通协作能力，能适应一定频率的出差。

加分项
1. 有 AGV、SCARA、Delta、协作机器人相关电控开发经验；

3. 能独立编写技术协议、验收标准、调试手册。

title: Paid Advertising Manager
text:
Job description (职位描述):
负责国内科研人群（高校、研究所、企业研发部门等）的精准广告投放策略制定、执行与优化，通过数据驱动实现高质量用户注册增长，支撑网站在国内市场的用户规模目标。
核心职责
1. 渠道策略与投放执行
  - 主导国内主流广告渠道的投放管理：
    - 搜索广告：百度搜索、360搜索、Bing
    - 信息流广告：微信朋友圈、字节系、B站、小红书（定向高校/科研机构用户群体）。
    - 应用市场：苹果，华为，荣耀，oppo,vivo,小米
2. 精准定向与人群洞察
  - 基于科研人员画像（学科领域、职位层级、机构类型、研究阶段）设计定向策略：
    - 利用平台DMP/工具（如百度观星盘、腾讯广告标签）锁定目标人群。
    - 与数据团队协作，构建科研人群模型，扩大精准触达范围。
3. 创意优化与素材管理
  - 主导广告创意策划，确保内容符合科研人群需求：
    - 突出专业性（如“提升30%文献综述效率”“Nature子刊作者推荐”）。
    - 设计场景化素材（实验室场景、学术会议画面、工具操作演示）。
4. 数据驱动与效果分析
  - 搭建投放数据监控体系（注册成本CPA、激活率、留存率、LTV）。
  - 每日/周输出投放报告，定位问题并提出优化方案（如调整出价、优化落地页、暂停低效计划）。
  - 与产品、内容团队协作，推动体验优化（如简化注册流程、增强信任背书）。

Requirements (职位要求):
硬性条件
1. 学历：本科及以上学历
2. 经验要求：
  - 5年以上国内主流广告平台独立投放经验（独立操作账户）。
  - 成功案例：需提供过往投放案例。
3. 技能要求：
  - 精通广告平台后台操作
  - 熟练使用数据分析工具（Excel高级函数、Google Analytics、神策/GrowingIO）。
软性能力
1. 科研行业敏感度：了解科研人员工作场景与痛点，能精准传递产品价值。
2. 数据思维：能从数据中定位问题，快速迭代策略（非仅执行层）。
3. 抗压能力：适应高强度节奏，能同时管理多渠道、多项目并行。
4. 沟通协作：与设计、产品、销售团队高效协同，推动跨部门项目落地。
加分项
- 有AI工具、SaaS产品或科研服务（如试剂、仪器）投放经验者。
- 了解科研人群行为和痛点。
- 从0-1项目成功经验。

title: AI Experimental Characterization Intern (Large Models)

text:

电解液是离子电池中不可或缺的组成部分，其性能直接影响电池的效率、寿命、安全性和环境适应性。随着电池技术的不断进步，对电解液的研究和开发仍然是电池科学领域的一个重要课题。作为深势科技离子电池电解液方向“AI for Science”（AI4S）实习生，您将与团队的其他研究者与工程师合作，利用包括人工智能、分子模拟等建模方法结合自动化实验等先进表征方法，研究电解液领域内的关键问题。

2. 挖掘业界真实场景，并与相关人员积极互动沟通，推进先进算法与先进实验手段结合，提升电解液产业研发效能。

title: Intelligent Electrolyte R&D Intern
title_original: 电解液智能研发实习生
text:
Job description (职位描述):
电解液决定离子电池的效率、寿命与安全。你将参与 Uni-ELF 电解液配方预训练模型 与 电解液研发 Agent 的研发落地，并与材料仿真与自动化实验团队协作，围绕 MD/QM 工具链优化 打通“数据—模型—仿真/实验”的闭环。

1.模型研发：多任务/多模态预训练与微调（结构、配方、仿真/实验、谱学/EIS 等）；面向导电率、黏度、稳定窗口、溶解度、界面相容性等任务的迁移与评测；引入不确定性估计、主动学习/贝叶斯优化，提升跨温度/浓度外推能力；模型服务化与推理加速，支撑批量筛选与闭环调用。
2.电解液 Agent（工具链与闭环优化）：具备规划与工具调用能力，串联 DFT/MD 计算、数据库、自动化实验/表征；构建/接入电解液知识库与 RAG，按约束生成与筛选配方；结合 BO/强化学习实现实验优先级排序与闭环优化，制定可量化评测指标。
3.MD/QM 工具链优化（材料计算开发）：对现有 MD/QM 工作流进行性能剖析与加速（输入参数与收敛策略优化、GPU、并行/MPI）；开发/维护高通量计算工作流：任务编排（调度）、重试与断点续跑、结果校验与追踪；物性计算流程标准化（扩散系数/导电率、Green-Kubo 黏度、RDF/SDF、溶剂化能、氧化/还原电位、反应路径等），与 Uni-ELF/Agent 对接形成可复用算子；持续基准与 V&V：对标文献/实验，建立数据质量度量与数据卡。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.编程与系统：熟练 Python（加分：C++），Linux 环境，良好的工程化与调试能力；
2.机器学习基础：理解常见模型与训练范式；熟练 PyTorch/JAX/TF 之一；
3.计算与仿真：至少熟练一款 DFT(ABACUS/VASP/CP2K)或 MD(LAMMPS/GROMACS)软件，并熟悉软件参数；熟练 ASE/pymatgen/MDAnalysis 等生态，能编写批量流程与后处理脚本;
4.协作与学习：主动性强，善于跨学科沟通与问题分解。

加分项
1.分子/材料方向 GNN/Transformer/等变模型实作；ML 势（DeepMD/NequIP/MACE/Allegro）或QM/MM、粗粒化、多尺度计算等经验；
2.有二次开发与插件化经验，包括自定义 LAMMPS fix/compute、ABACUS/CP2K 批处理脚本、ASE/pymatgen 工作流、MDAnalysis/OVITO 结果后处理；
3.Agent/RAG/工具调用框架经验；BO/主动学习/不确定性估计实战；
4.HPC 与 MLOps（容器化、任务编排、数据/实验追踪、可视化报表）；
5.电解液实验或自动化经验（EIS、CV、装配与老化、实验调度）。

title: AI4S winter internship programme
title_original: 招募AI4S追光者-深势科技寒假实习生计划
text:
Job description (职位描述):
我们正在招募参与 AI for Science 长期实践的 Light Chasers。

我们正在推动Agentic Science at Scale 的新实践：当科学问题的边界不断拓展、个人与工具之间的限制逐步消解时，那些同时具备好奇心、判断力与行动力的人，开始拥有更大的创造空间——能够把探索做深、做实，并持续向前推进，而不再受制于零散条件与偶发路径。这种实践不只是 AI for Science，也是 Science for AI：科学式的约束、验证与执行闭环，正在把智能从“会拟合、会生成”，推向目标驱动、可验证、可演进的能力形态。

我们正在寻找的，是真正希望并能够带来改变、推动范式演进的人。我们期待你以持久的好奇心进入未知，以自驱行动把想法落到实处，对路径与结果负责；也期待你既保持独立判断，又能够在一个志同道合、和而不同的环境中高质量协作。我们坚持开放与共享，要求研究在真实需求环境中经受验证；论文与成果，应当来自问题被持续推进的过程，而不是反过来决定工作的方向。

如果你对此感到不是退缩、而是激动，渴望亲历并参与这场变革，从中锻炼自己、成长为 AI 赋能的新时代人才，那么你就是我们在寻找的同路人。

一、主要方向
1. 科学文献的多模态大模型：提升对图表、公式、谱图/显微图像、化学分子结构与反应过程等多模态信息的理解、对齐与推理能力。
2. AI for Science 基础模型：面向蛋白质、小分子、晶体与材料体系的生成与设计，建立可控、可评估、可迭代的基础生成模型与优化框架，用于真实研发场景的加速与落地。
3. 智能实验室与实验操作系统：研制统一的实验室操作系统与 AI 原生实验仪器，打通实验流程、仪器控制与数据回流，使实验成为可编程、可验证的执行与反馈层。
4. 智能体赋能科学发现：将知识、模型、工具与实验接口组织为可执行、可验证的智能体工作流，加速各领域科学发现，并在持续反馈中迭代优化。
5. AI4S Infra：构建支撑大规模 AI4S实践的统一基础设施体系，涵盖数据基础设施、智能体运行基础设施以及 HPC 与 AI 融合算力基础设施，保障科学智能系统的稳定运行、规模扩展与效率提升。

Requirements (职位要求):
二、任职要求
1. 全日制本硕博，专业不限，逻辑思维扎实。
2. 动手能力强，可快速落地技术构想（代码能力强 / 或善用 LLM 工具均可）。
3. 具备良好沟通协作能力，适应前沿研发节奏。

三、我们提供
1. 顶尖科学家一对一指导。
2. 充足 LLM 资源与算力支持。
3. 有竞争力的实习补贴。
4. 真实产品落地与线上发布机会。 
5. 精英团队与前沿技术交流环境。

四、应聘方式
1. 欢迎扫描下方二维码提交简历和项目提议，请在简历中标注“到岗时间-实习时长-意向城市”，请在扫码投递时请以作品的形式将项目提议上传至附件/描述。我们将尽快组织简历筛选。
关于项目提议：
既然你对 AI for Science 感兴趣，相信你心里一定有想认真做成的一件事。它可以落在我们上面提到的几个方向之内，也可以是你认为值得投入的其他主题——只要你提出，我们就会认真评估，并尽可能为你创造落地实现的机会。
项目提议请尽量简洁（不超过 500 字），建议包含三部分：
- 具体目标：你要解决什么问题、产出是什么；
- 核心价值：为什么值得做，能带来什么增益或突破；
- 可行性简析：关键路径、所需数据/资源、主要风险与验证方式。
（推荐阅读：arxiv: 2512.20469）
2. 实习时间要求：每周3天及以上，3-6个月，欢迎长期实习。
3. 实习薪资：1000元-2000元/天。
4. 工作地点：北京/上海/深圳/线上。

title: Chemical Data Annotation Intern, Molecule Library Project
title_original: 化学信息标注实习生 - 分子库项目
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1. 负责化学专利解析数据的深度清洗与质量校验，通过Bad Case分析与规则优化分子识别准确率；
2. 构建“金标”分子数据集，针对专利中的复杂化学结构（如马库什结构、手性异构体、盐型等）进行精确标注与校验，为模型训练提供高置信度基准；
3. 设计并验证化学后处理规则，将化学专家知识转化为可执行的算法逻辑，修正OCR错误、骨架识别偏移及立体化学翻转问题；
4. 参与化学数据质量体系建设，制定分子结构标准化、去盐及价态平衡校验的SOP流程；
5. 与算法团队紧密协作，对模型解析的中间产物进行归因分析，从数据侧驱动Parser模型的迭代升级。

Requirements (职位要求):
1. 熟练使用 ChemDraw / MarvinSketch / RDKit / OpenBabel 等化学绘图与信息学工具；
2. 精通 Python，具备使用脚本进行化学数据批量处理、格式转换或自动化校验的能力；
3. 深刻理解有机化学命名法（IUPAC），精通 SMILES / InChI / InChIKey / Mol Block / SDF 等分子结构表示形式及其转换逻辑；
4. 有化学信息学、计算化学、药物化学或有机化学相关专业硕博背景，对立体化学（R/S构型、E/Z异构）有极高的敏感度；
5. 有“像素级”的数据纠错能力，能够快速识别并修正复杂的化学结构绘制错误（如价态异常、芳香性缺失等）；
6. 需线下实习，每周到岗5天，可以实习三个月及以上。

加分项：
1. 理解马库什（Markush）通式结构的解析逻辑与枚举规则；
2. 有论文和专利数据挖掘或构建高精度化学反应/分子数据库的项目经验；
3. 熟悉 OCSR（光学化学结构识别） 技术原理，或使用过 MolVec / DECIMER / ChemGrapher 等工具。

4.模型迭代： 进行多模态大模型的微调与评估。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.技术基础： 熟悉 LLM 原理，对 Transformer 架构、RAG 或多模态学习有实际理解。
2.工程能力： 精通 Python，具备扎实的数据处理功底，能独立完成自动化脚本编写。
3.实习时间： 能够稳定实习 3 个月以上，每周在岗 4 天及以上。

加分项：

2.架构经验： 熟悉 LangChain、AutoGPT 或 CrewAI 等 Agent 框架。

1.顶尖工业界视野： 深度参与“AI for Science”完整落地全链路。
2.硬核技术积累： 掌握多模态解析及大规模结构化数据治理的实战经验。
3.跨界思维： 站在 AI 与材料科学的交叉点，培养解决复杂科学问题的工程思维。

5. 具有较强的学习能力与自我驱动力，能够快速掌握新知识、新技术，适应行业快速发展的需求。

title: Account Manager
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1.负责材料化工相关行业新客户拓展及现有客户关系维护，完成公司下达的销售目标；
2.理解材料化工客户业务场景及需求，推广公司解决方案、产品及服务，协调解决方案、技术、算法、交付等团队提供支持；

2.有3-5年相关材料化工行业销售及项目运作经验，锂电行业优先；

title: Data Engineering / Data Intelligence Intern
title_original: 数据工程/数据智能实习生
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1.协助团队完成数据全生命周期的基础处理工作，包括但不限于数据清洗、格式转换与质量校验，确保下游分析与应用的数据准确性与可用性。
2.参与内部数据工具与基础平台的维护与轻量化开发，利用Python及相关库提升数据预处理与处理的自动化水平。
3.探索和实践基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据智能体（Data Agent） 基础功能，协助开发用于数据查询、检验或分析的初级原型工具。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.计算机、数据科学或相关专业在读本科生或研究生。
2.掌握 Python 为核心编程语言。
3.掌握 Django 框架开发能力。
4.对数据库有基本了解，接触过一种或以上（如 MySQL, Doris，Clickhouse，MongoDB, Redis 等），有编写基础SQL语句的能力。
5.对大语言模型（LLM）应用开发或智能体（Agent） 概念有基本了解和浓厚兴趣者优先。
6.具备良好的逻辑思维、学习能力和团队协作精神。

title: Computer Vision Algorithm Intern
title_original: 计算机视觉（CV）算法实习生
text:
Job description (职位描述):
参与科学文献解析视觉模型算法的开发与研究，从非结构化的科学文献图像中，抽取结构化的信息，并用于下游更广泛的应用。内容包括且不限于文献版面识别、图表理解，表格解析，反应式解析，通用OCR等，对流程中某些部分算法进行深入探究，并将研究成果转化为学术论文。 
职位职责： 
1. 视觉模型训练各阶段方法设计与研究，解决科学文献解析任务中的问题和需求； 
2. 参与规模训练数据集的构建，确保数据质量和多样性； 
3. 进行模型性能分析，识别和解决训练过程中的瓶颈，优化推理效率。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.拥有扎实的编程能力，精通至少一种编程语言，熟悉主流深度学习框架（如 PyTorch / TensorFlow 等）； 
2.对计算机视觉领域具有一定的理论基础与实践经验，熟悉常见视觉任务及技术路线，包括但不限于目标检测、实例分割、OCR等； 
3.熟悉经典的模型结构（如 YOLO、RCNN、ViT等相关视觉模型），具备模型训练、调参与评估的能力；
4.优秀的文献阅读能力与良好的沟通协作能力； 
5.每周出勤不低于3天，可以base北京/上海，亦可远程实习。
加分项：
1. 在CV领域发表过顶刊论文；
2. 熟悉多模态相关的算法和技术，具备多模态大模型训练经验，如Qwen-VL等；
3.参与过CV或多模态大模型相关重要开源项目、数据科学比赛等。

title: Product Operations Intern
text:
Job description (职位描述):
深度参与玻尔的日常运营与迭代优化工作，围绕用户体验与关键业务指标，通过数据分析与用户洞察推动产品持续改进。主要工作职责如下：
1.产品数据监控与分析：协助搭建与维护核心数据看板，日常监控活跃、转化、留存等关键指标；基于数据变化进行分析，输出明确结论，发现产品体验与用户行为中的问题和机会点。
2.埋点方案与数据建设：参与功能级埋点方案设计，梳理用户行为路径、关键事件与指标口径；使用 Quick Tracking 等工具完成埋点配置、校验与排查，保障数据准确可用。
3.产品优化与验证：基于数据与用户反馈，协助撰写产品优化需求与实验假设；参与 A/B 测试或灰度方案的执行与分析，跟进上线后的效果复盘。
4.研发协同与上线：在开发与测试阶段协助核对功能实现与埋点情况，确保方案落地；参与上线前运营侧验收，上线后监控核心数据并推动问题闭环。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.本科或研究生在读，专业不限，有 AI 产品 / 数据分析 / 产品相关实习或项目经验者优先。
2.对 AI 产品和用户体验敏感，愿意通过数据驱动产品优化。
3.具备基础的数据分析能力，了解常见产品指标。
4.了解埋点方案设计思路（事件、属性、用户行为路径等），有实际参与经验更佳。
5.逻辑清晰，沟通能力好，能与产品、研发高效协作。
6.学习能力强，执行力高，对细节和数据准确性有要求。
7.线下实习，可以连续实习 3 个月及以上，每周到岗 3-5 天。

title: Full-Stack Engineer, Scientific Agents (Agents4Science)
title_original: 全栈工程师—科学智能体 Agents4Science
text:
Job description (职位描述):
职位愿景
您将成为构建“科学智能体”（Agents4Science）核心基础设施的关键工程师。作为全栈工程师，您不仅需要精通前后端开发，更要能够理解并实现 AI 智能体在科研场景中的复杂交互逻辑。您将亲手搭建一个能让 AI 直接驱动科研实验与发现的平台，让“自动化科学家”真正走进现实。
核心职责
1. 系统架构与平台开发
  - 设计与实现科学智能体的整体架构，包括前端界面、后端服务、数据管道与智能体调用层。
  - 构建高性能、可扩展的科研工作流平台（如实验管理、任务调度、Agent 编排等）。
  - 与 AI/ML 团队协作，将大语言模型（LLM）与科研任务接口无缝集成（如推理、检索、计算模块）。
2. 前端开发与交互体验
  - 使用 React / Next.js / Vue 等框架打造现代化科学界面，支持实验设计、Agent 控制台、可视化数据分析。
  - 与产品、设计协作，实现科学家易用且可信赖的交互体验。
  - 构建交互式组件库（如 Notebook 界面、可编程面板、图谱可视化）。
3. 后端与数据层开发
  - 负责平台核心后端逻辑，包括用户管理、任务调度、智能体编排、模型服务调用。
  - 熟悉 Python / FastAPI / Node.js / Go 等主流技术栈，能够编写高质量、高并发的后端服务。
  - 设计高效的数据结构与 API 接口，支持科研数据与 AI 模型交互。
4. AI 集成与工程落地
  - 将大语言模型、Agent 框架（如 LangChain、OpenDevin、AutoGPT）与科学应用（化学模拟、材料筛选、文献分析等）深度结合。
  - 实现智能体间通信、上下文记忆与任务自动化流程。
  - 优化模型推理性能与前后端协作流程，支持分布式部署与云端执行。
5. 协作与创新
  - 与产品经理、AI 科学家密切合作，从 0 到 1 推进核心产品落地。
  - 在快速迭代中平衡工程质量与创新探索，推动工程体系化与标准化。
  - 参与架构评审、代码审核与开源模块建设。

Requirements (职位要求):
任职要求
- 3–7 年全栈开发经验，具备独立构建复杂 Web 平台的能力
- 熟悉主流前端框架（React / Next.js / Vue）与现代前端工程化（TypeScript、Tailwind、Vite）
- 熟练掌握至少一种后端语言（Python / Go / Node.js）及对应框架（FastAPI、Express、Gin 等）
- 具备良好的系统设计能力，对 API 设计、数据库建模、消息队列、缓存等有深入理解
- 熟悉云原生与部署流程（Docker / Kubernetes / CI/CD / Cloud Functions）
- 能够快速理解 AI 应用接口与 LLM 调用机制（如 OpenAI / HuggingFace / LangChain SDK）
优先条件
- 曾参与从 0 到 1 的 AI 平台、科研软件、自动化工具或智能体系统建设
- 有 AI 工程或数据基础设施经验（如模型服务化、检索增强、LLM Orchestration）
- 熟悉科研领域（如化学计算、生物信息学、实验自动化）或科研工作流产品
- 对 AI for Science 充满热情，愿意在科研与工程结合的前沿探索新范式
- 具备开源项目经验或技术社区活跃度（GitHub、Arxiv、HuggingFace Hub 等）
我们提供
- 🚀 参与塑造下一代“科学智能体”生态的机会
- 🌍 与顶尖 AI 研究员、科学家协作，共同推动科研自动化革命
- 💡 开放创新的文化与灵活的工程探索空间
- 💰 具竞争力的薪资 + 股权激励计划
- 🧠 访问顶级 AI 模型、计算资源与科研伙伴网络

title: Delivery Engineer
text:
Job description (职位描述):
- 项目交付与部署：主导项目私有化环境的部署实施，包括复杂网络环境下的架构搭建、配置调优及联调测试；能够快速定位并解决部署过程中出现的各类技术问题，确保系统稳定上线。
- 技术支持与验收：为用户提供现场或远程的技术支持，进行系统操作培训、功能演示及技术答疑；配合项目经理完成项目汇报、阶段性验收及交付文档的归档工作。
- 环境运维与知识沉淀：负责交付环境的日常维护、监控及故障排查，建立完善的维护记录；整理并输出常见问题解决方案（FAQ）、运维手册及最佳实践，形成标准化的知识库。

Requirements (职位要求):
- 学历与经验：本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业；具备2年以上IT运维、项目交付或实施经验，拥有中大型项目私有化部署成功案例者优先。
- 技术能力：具备扎实的Linux系统基础，熟悉文件系统、Cgroups等底层原理；熟练掌握Golang或Python至少一门编程语言，具备独立编写自动化运维脚本或工具的能力。

title: Uni-Lab OS Product Manager
text:

text:
Job description (职位描述):
关于 Uni-Lab-OS
我们自主研发的 AI 原生实验室操作系统，首个核心场景是液体处理工作站自动化。目标：让 AI Agent 直接编排复杂液体处理实验。
 • 论文：UniLabOS: An AI-Native Operating System for Autonomous Laboratories（arXiv:2512.21766）
 • 开源仓库：github.com/deepmodeling/Uni-Lab-OS（GPL-3.0）

职位描述
1. 驱动开发与协议适配
 • 开发主流移液工作站驱动（Opentrons、Hamilton、Tecan、Beckman 等）
 • 集成 PyLabRobot 框架，统一 Python 接口
 • 适配 HTTP/TCP/串口/厂商 SDK 等通信协议
 • 封装原子化操作：吸液、分液、混匀、转移等
 • 处理物理约束：液面检测、防碰撞、死体积补偿
2. 协议编排引擎
 • 将实验意图翻译为设备指令序列
 • 实现 Dry Run 模拟，验证逻辑、预估耗材
 • 对接 AI Agent，定义 tool-calling schema
3. 产品定义
 • 定义功能边界、优先级与路线图
 • 设计协议编辑器：可视化拖拽 + 代码编辑双模式
 • 分析用户需求（高校、药企、CRO），优先支持高频场景

Requirements (职位要求):
 1. 2 年以上开发经验，1 年以上实验室自动化/仪器控制相关
 2. 精通 Python，有实际项目经验
 3. 使用过至少一种主流移液工作站，理解移液物理原理
 4. 有仪器 SDK/API 对接经验，熟悉 REST/TCP/串口至少一种
 5. 具备产品思维，能写 PRD 和功能规格文档

加分项
 1. 生命科学背景，有湿实验经验
 2. 熟悉 PyLabRobot、Opentrons API 或 Hamilton Venus
 3. 了解 SiLA 2、OPC UA 等实验室自动化协议
 4. 有 LIMS/ELN 产品开发经验
 5. 熟悉 NGS、PCR、ELISA 等分子生物学流程
 6. 有 AI Agent/LLM tool-calling 开发经验

text:

你将直接参与 Coding Agent 和 仪器控制 Agent 的开发与调优，接触大量真实的科研仪器自动化任务，驱动前沿科研设备解决有挑战性的专家级问题。

岗位职责

- 参与构建下一代科研仪器智能化平台的研发
- 开发和优化专有领域 Coding Agent 系统，提升代码生成质量与上下文理解能力

2.仪器控制 Agent 方向
- 开发设备适配层（Device Adapter），将海量科学仪器封装为 Agent 可调用的标准操作
- 构建和优化仪器仿真器（Simulator），实现在无物理设备环境下的 Agent 调试与测试
- 设计 Agent 驱动的自动化实验工作流（Workflow），编排多设备协同的复杂科研任务
- 参与科研仪器智能化改造：从仪器手册 PDF 自动提取知识，映射 SDK 接口，生成设备定义与仿真器
- 优化 Agent 在真实仪器操控中的安全性、鲁棒性和异常恢复能力

Requirements (职位要求):
- 985/211 高校在读硕士（计算机科学、人工智能、自动化、电子工程或相关专业）
- 扎实的 Python 编程能力，熟悉异步编程（asyncio）
- 对 LLM / AI Agent 技术有浓厚兴趣，了解 Harness Engineering 基本概念
- 良好的英文文档阅读能力
- 每周至少投入 4 天，实习期不少于 3 个月
  
加分项

- 有科学仪器操作经验或科研实验背景（物理、化学、材料科学等）
- 了解 DAG 工作流引擎、状态机设计
- 有开源项目贡献经验
  
你将获得
- 🔬 前沿科研场景：直接接触 FIB-SEM、STM、TEM 等顶级科研仪器的自动化控制任务，将 AI 能力落地到真实科研流程

text:

5.AI4S Infra：构建支撑大规模 AI4S 实践的统一基础设施体系，涵盖数据基础设施、大模型后训练与强化学习基础设施、智能体运行基础设施以及 HPC 与 AI 融合算力基础设施，保障科学智能系统的稳定运行、规模扩展与效率提升。

title: NLP / Knowledge Graph Algorithm Intern
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1. 参与知识图谱平台中信息抽取、事件识别、关系降噪和知识补全相关算法模块的研发与实验。
2. 参与基于强化学习的句子选择器设计，从未标注文本中筛选高价值句子，辅助人工标注，提高模型训练效率。
3. 参与主动学习、局部学习相关标注辅助策略实验，优化样本选择和标注推荐效果。
4. 参与基于强化学习的关系降噪模型实验，过滤弱标注或远程监督语料中的噪声句子，提升关系抽取准确率。
5. 参与知识图谱补全中的路径搜索和策略学习实验，支持实体关系预测和缺失关系发现。
6. 跟踪并复现相关论文或开源项目，完成实验记录、效果评估和技术文档。

Requirements (职位要求):
1. 计算机、人工智能、软件工程、数据科学等相关专业，本科高年级或硕士在读优先。
2. 熟悉 Python，熟悉 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow，有模型训练和实验调试经验。
3. 了解 NLP 基础任务，如文本分类、实体识别、关系抽取、事件抽取等。
4. 了解知识图谱基本概念，如实体、关系、三元组、schema、实体对齐、知识补全等。
5. 了解强化学习基础概念，如状态、动作、奖励、策略、episode、policy gradient 等。
6. 具备论文阅读和开源项目复现能力，能够记录实验过程、参数、指标和结论。

加分项：
1. 有知识图谱、信息抽取、事件抽取、关系抽取、实体消歧或知识补全项目经验。
2. 了解主动学习、弱监督、远程监督、半监督学习等方法。
3. 复现过 DQN、REINFORCE、Actor-Critic、PPO 等强化学习算法。
4. 了解 TransE、RotatE、ComplEx、R-GCN、DeepPath、MINERVA 等知识图谱补全方法。
5. 熟悉 Embedding、向量检索、RAG、LLM 辅助标注或图数据库者优先。
6. 有基于vibe Coding的项目开发经验。

title: Wet-Lab R&D Engineer
text:
Job description (职位描述):
在一线负责人指导下，参与湿实验体系搭建和标准化工作，结合智能化/自动化实验平台，执行管线实验并整理实验数据与报告。在 3–6 个月内，逐步从稳定执行者成长为能提出实验方案并交付结果的独立承担人。

工作职责
1.参与实验体系搭建
- 根据项目目标，协助设计和搭建实验流程、标准操作规程(SOP)
- 对现有实验流程进行梳理、记录和规范化
2.实验执行与数据产出
- 按照既定方案，独立完成微生物表达、蛋白纯化及酶活/功能测定等湿实验操作，确保数据质量与可重复性
- 及时整理实验记录和原始数据，完成阶段性实验报告
3.实验设计与优化
- 在熟悉现有体系后，参与实验方案设计及表达/纯化/反应条件优化
- 针对实验中出现的问题，提出改进思路并进行验证
4.智能化实验室协同
- 配合智能化/自动化实验室，完成管线实验的执行和调试
- 与算法/工程同事协作，提出有利于自动化与数据分析的实验改进建议
5.外送检测协调
- 按规范准备外送样品(如手性 HPLC、LC-MS、GC-MS、NGS 等)，对接 CRO 并跟踪结果回收与归档
6.结果汇报与沟通
- 定期向负责人汇报实验进展和结果，输出结构化实验报告
- 在 3–6 个月内，逐步承担“小课题/小项目”的方案与结果交付

Requirements (职位要求):
1.学历/经验背景(二者满足其一即可)
- 应届硕士，生物、医学、化学、生物工程、药学或相关专业
- 本科，1 年及以上、3 年以下生物实验相关经验
2.专业能力
- 至少熟练掌握 1–2 类常用生物学湿实验技术(如分子克隆、蛋白表达纯化、蛋白/酶活检测等)，有扎实的实验动手能力
- 熟悉大肠杆菌等常规微生物表达系统者优先;熟悉枯草芽孢杆菌、毕赤酵母、曲霉等宿主更佳
- 具备比色法/紫外分光光度法等酶活测定基础，能理解实验原理并据此做基本条件优化
- 对数据质量敏感，具备良好的实验记录和文档习惯
3.经验加分项(非必须)
- 有独立负责过小课题/毕业课题/项目中关键实验模块的经历
- 有 Ni-NTA 亲和纯化、SDS-PAGE、SEC、DLS、Tm 测定等蛋白表征经验
- 有与自动化平台、智能化实验室或高通量实验相关经验
- 有 CRO 外送样品准备与对接经验(手性 HPLC、LC-MS、GC-MS、NGS 等)
- 会使用基础数据分析工具(如 GraphPad、R/Python 中任一)整理和初步分析实验数据
4.个人特质
- 学习能力强，愿意在 3–6 个月内快速成长为“能给方案、出结果”的核心执行
- 认真细致，踏实可靠，对实验重复性和结果负责
- 沟通顺畅，能主动汇报问题和进展，不"闷头做实验"
- 接受长期在呼和浩特站点工作
5.发展路径与期待
- 0–3 个月:熟悉实验体系与智能化实验平台，稳定完成高质量实验执行
- 3–6 个月:能在指导下独立完成小项目的实验设计与优化，并交付方案+结果
- 6 个月以后:逐步成长为某一方向的小项目负责人，有机会参与课题规划和技术路线设计

title: Chemical Data QC Intern, Molecule Library Project
title_original: 化学数据质检实习生 - 分子库项目
text:
Job description (职位描述):
1.项目冷启动与流程迭代：在项目早期阶段，负责抽样阅读和比对化学专利/文献，总结并归纳机器解析的常见错误类型（Bad Case），协助团队迭代和优化数据处理管线（Pipeline）及操作规范（SOP）；
2.外包团队管理与赋能：协助管理外部的数据标注团队，负责下发任务、答疑解惑，确保外包人员准确理解化学结构的标注规则；
3.数据复核与质量验收（核心）：对外包团队提交的标注结果进行抽样复核与终检。通过“找茬”揪出复杂结构（如马库什结构、手性异构体、盐型等）的绘制错误，统计整体错误率，并向外包团队输出反馈报告；
4.疑难数据终审：针对外包团队无法处理的疑难化学结构，利用自身专业知识进行人工定夺与修复（如立体化学翻转、骨架偏移等）；
5.维护“金标”分子数据集，把控最终产出数据的整体化学准确性。

Requirements (职位要求):
1.专业：“生化环材”（生物、化学、环境、材料）等相关专业本科及以上学历（如有机化学、药物化学、应用化学、高分子材料等）。
2.绘图熟练：熟练使用 ChemDraw / MarvinSketch / Ketcher 等化学绘图工具，能够快速、规范地绘制与核对复杂化学结构；
3.化学基本功扎实：熟悉 IUPAC 命名法，对立体化学（R/S构型、E/Z异构）、价态异常、芳香性缺失等常识性错误具备“火眼金睛”，能一眼识破；
4.了解格式：了解 SMILES / InChI / SDF 等常见分子结构表示形式（会用工具查验即可，无需编程处理）；
5.沟通与执行力（关键）：不仅自己要懂化学，还要能把错误原因清晰地传达给外包团队。做事踏实严谨、耐心细致，具备优秀的纠错能力和质量把控意识；
6.实习时间：支持线上远程或线下实习，需保证每周工作时间达 5 天，可以连续实习 3 个月及以上。
加分项：
1.有数据标注质检（QA）、外包团队对接或项目管理经验；
2.了解马库什（Markush）通式结构的阅读与枚举逻辑；
3.有过化学数据标注经验
对有机化学领域有独到见解

title: Antibody Researcher
text:
Job description (职位描述):
该岗位定位为扎实湿实验执行能力的研究员，入职后承担实验模块的独立执行，同时通过部门内训逐步建立计算辅助能力，成长为具备算法协作能力的复合型科学家。入职1年内逐渐成长为部门蛋白表达纯化的默认对接人；同步参与干实验培训机制，第二年起能参与数据构建讨论，提供实验侧的标注质量判断，逐步承担算法验证设计工作。
